normalized.description: Generating embeddings for large-scale EO datasets involves significant engineering considerations: data must be efficiently pre-processed, batched, and passed through embedding models, often in HPC and other distributed systems capable to handle millions or billions of inputs. In EO, data formats, data projections, data storage and data retrieval are critical, requiring optimized techniques and tools to maintain performance and scale embedding generation to regional and global scale. In addition, ensuring generated embeddings are usable for a wide range of downstream applications and are coherently updated when new EO data is acquired are other key challenges. Several efforts in the past, such as work performed with MajorTOM in the ESA -lab, showed how these challenges can be an important limitation for scaling embeddings and AI models and ultimately fully utilize the vast amount of Earth Observation data acquired by ESA and non-ESA missions. The objective of this activity is to develop technologies, methods and tools required to establish a system capable of generating, retrieving and utilizing embeddings at regional and global scale from multimodal EO data (e.g., Sentinel missions at different product levels, VHR data, SAR data...).
